# ELIPAN Group

> ELIPAN Group is a Chicago company that builds AI products with people at the center. AI drafts and suggests; a person reviews and decides. Founded by Marcos Cuellar.

## Brands
- [NENEMI](https://www.mynenemi.com/): An ADHD workspace. Step away, come back, and see where you left off.
- [CUEPA for Work](https://www.makingcuepa.com/): Workflows and applied AI for small businesses.
- [CUEPA for You](https://you.makingcuepa.com/): One-on-one AI coaching for everyday life.
- [ŌLLIN OS/GO](https://www.ollinos.com/): Verified account signals for staffing sales. ŌLLIN GO, built in, turns them into outreach a person approves.

## How we work
- CHIMAL, our audit: every draft is checked four ways before it ships (cites its source, a second AI tries to break it, checked line by line, a person decides).
- Nothing is sent without a person's OK.
